:::{#def-matrix-inner-product}
#### Matrix inner product

The **inner product** of two $n \times p$ matrices $\matr{A}$ and $\matr{B}$ is

$$
\iprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}
\eqdef
\tr\paren{\underbrace{\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{B}}_{p \times p}}
$$

:::

::: notes
@banerjee2014linear [Chapter 15, eq. 15.7, p. 491]
defines the same inner product on $n \times p$ matrices with the trace.
:::
